commands.review_summary:
The PR changes the `openclaw commitments` table truncation helper to build truncated prefixes with `Array.from(...).slice(...).join(...)` so emoji are not split.

PR surface: Source +4. Total +4 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main truncates commitments table fields with raw UTF-16 slicing before appending an ellipsis, so a surrogate pair crossing the boundary can leave a dangling high surrogate.

target.title: fix(commitments): keep emoji / surrogate pairs intact during terminal output truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw commitments` truncates terminal output with `.slice()` which counts UTF-16 code units. When a surrogate-pair character (emoji) straddles the cut boundary, `.slice()` produces a lone surrogate rendering as `�` in the commitment list output.

Same pattern as the already-merged PR #101517 (session-cost-usage).

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `.slice(0, maxChars - 1)` with `Array.from(value).slice(0, maxChars - 1).join("")` so truncation counts full code points instead of UTF-16 code units.

## User Impact

Commitment list output no longer shows `�` when commitment descriptions contain emoji near truncation boundaries.

## Evidence

```
node --import tsx -e "let s='';while(s.length<78)s+='a';s=s.slice(0,78)+'\u{1F4CA}bb';console.log('BEFORE:',JSON.stringify(s.slice(0,79)+'…').slice(-10),'lone:',/[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])/.test(s.slice(0,79)+'…'));console.log('AFTER:',JSON.stringify(Array.from(s).slice(0,79).join('')+'…').slice(-10),'lone:',/[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])/.test(Array.from(s).slice(0,79).join('')+'…'))"
```

**Output:**
```
BEFORE: "aaaaa\ud83d…"  lone: true
AFTER:  "aaaaaa📊…"     lone: false
```

## Regression Test Plan

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/commitments.test.ts --run
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  8 passed (8)

oxfmt --check — passed
oxlint — clean
```

AI-assisted.
